Functieomschrijving:
As a Quality Control Employee, you are the guardian of quality throughout the production process. You will inspect products, identify deviations, and collaborate with operators and team leaders to ensure quality. Your responsibilities include:
• Performing quality checks on products and materials.
• Checking whether products meet the specified requirements.
• Identifying and reporting deviations in the production process.
• Recording measurement data and quality checks.
• Collaborating with operators to improve product quality.
• Contributing ideas for improvements within the quality process.

• Experience with quality control within a production environment.
• An accurate working method and a keen eye for detail.
• Good communication skills in Dutch or English.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift schedule.
• You enjoy working together with colleagues in production and quality.
